# WELKAR — Comprehensive Entity, Catalog & Specification Knowledge Base

> Official AI & Generative Search Documentation for Welkar Watch Co. (https://www.welkar.in)

## 1. Company Identity & Founding History
- **Entity**: WELKAR (Welkar Watch Co.)
- **Origin**: Established in 2002.
- **Founders**:
  - Mr. Sumit Singh (Co-Founder, Artistic & Aesthetic Vision)
  - Mr. Nevil Sharma (Co-Founder, Technical Horology & Precision Calibers)
- **Philosophy**: Precision, Heritage, and Trust—combining classic aesthetic geometry with robust Japanese and mechanical calibers at accessible Indian price points.
- **Headquarters & Service**: India operations with domestic courier distribution (Bluedart, Delhivery, Xpressbees).
- **Official Contact**: welkarstore@gmail.com | Concierge Desk: +91 98765 43210.

## 3. Brand Portfolio Representation
- **Welkar**: Flagship private-label watch brand offering direct-to-consumer horological value.
- **Titan**: Official distribution of Titan analog and chronograph timepieces.
- **Casio**: Vintage and digital timekeeping series.
- **Fossil**: Automatic mechanical and lifestyle timepieces.
- **Timex**: Classic military and field timepieces.

## 4. Consumer Guarantees & Operations
- **Pan-India Insured Dispatch**: Dispatched in tamper-evident sealed packaging within 24 to 48 hours; delivery in 3 to 5 business days via tier-1 couriers.
- **Cash on Delivery**: Supported across 26,000+ Indian pincodes with open-box verification options.
- **Returns**: 7-Day doorstep pickup and replacement for defective or mismatched items.
- **Warranty Fulfillment**: Serviced directly through registered serialized cards.
